title: What Is a Good NPS Score? Industry Benchmarks for 2026

facts.fact: The page states that a good NPS score is over 30.
facts.quote: A good NPS score is over 30.

facts.fact: The page states that NPS ranges from -100 to +100.
facts.quote: Your score can range from -100 to +100.

facts.fact: The page cites data from over 150,000 organizations, attributed to SurveyMonkey, reporting an average NPS of 32.
facts.quote: the average NPS score is 32. The median is 44.

facts.fact: The page cites SurveyMonkey data from over 150,000 organizations giving a median NPS of 44.
facts.quote: the average NPS score is 32. The median is 44.

facts.fact: The page states that an NPS of 72 or above places a company in the top 25% globally.
facts.quote: And if you’re at 72 or above, you’re in the top 25% globally.

facts.fact: The page states that an NPS of 80 and above is world-class and very rarely achieved.
facts.quote: World-class. Very few companies ever get here.

facts.fact: The page defines NPS as the percentage of Promoters (scores 9 and 10) minus the percentage of Detractors (scores 0 to 6), with Passives (scores 7 and 8) excluded.
facts.quote: Passives (7s and 8s) don’t factor into the calculation at all.

facts.fact: The page gives a worked example: 200 respondents with 110 Promoters, 50 Passives and 40 Detractors yield an NPS of 35.
facts.quote: Say 200 people take your survey. 110 are Promoters. 50 are Passives. 40 are Detractors.

facts.fact: In Listen360's Fitness NPS Benchmark Report, as cited on the page, the gym franchise median is 57 and the top 25% threshold is 71 or higher.

facts.quote: That 88+ benchmark for boutique studios is notably high.
